value.rationale: The result gives a complete stable-range classification of a natural exact invariant: the least fourth Fourier moment, equivalently the best phase-only merit factor, for every four-point support in a prime cyclic group. It identifies repeated-difference geometry as the governing mechanism and singles out affine four-term progressions as the unique optimizers. This is structurally informative for sparse correlation design and is not a routine recomputation or a finite table.
